summary: Section L (Cost Sheet + Discount Approvals + Payment Plans + Proposals) end-to-end tested against Laravel 11 CRM at http://127.0.0.1:8000. Added /app/backend/tests/test_section_l.py with 14 pytest cases covering: payment-plans seed (CLP/DP/FLEXI milestones sum to 100), admin plan create, exec 403 on plan create, cost-sheet math (3% within_5 auto-approved with gst=400000, subtotal=8600000, disc=240000, total=8360000), 8% -> band=over_5 pending + DiscountApproval row created, 12% -> band=over_10 pending, proposal 422 while pending, exec 403 on decide, manager approve flips cost_sheet.discount_status=approved, manager reject sets rejected, counter with counter_pct=4 recomputes discount_amount=320000 and marks approved, full proposal flow (generate returns PROP-<ref>, send -> status=sent, consent {name:'Vikram Nair'} -> consent_captured=1, consent_name set, status=accepted), select-plan attaches payment_plan_id, share sets status=shared, GET /leads/{id}/cost-sheets returns {cost_sheets:[...],proposals:[...]}. RESULT: 14/14 Section L PASS + 26/26 Phase A regression PASS + 18/18 Phase B regression PASS = 58/58. Frontend Playwright confirmed: login admin@crm.local works, Payment Plans page (nav-plans) renders 4 cards (Construction Linked/Down Payment/Flexi/newly-added Test Plan) with milestone rows and percentages. Lead #1 Quote tab (tab-quote) accepts cs-base_price/cs-gst_rate/cs-registration_charges/cs-maintenance_charges/cs-discount_pct inputs, live cs-total updates to '₹83,60,000' for the 3% scenario. Full UI workflow observed in Activity timeline of Vikram Nair (lead 1): 'Cost sheet created · total ₹8,360,000' (x2), 'Discount 8% requested — pending manager approval', 'Email sent: Your special offer is approved', 'Discount request approved: ok', 'Proposal generated · PROP-20260809-7YBC', plus 'Approve discount 8% for Vikram Nair' escalation task in Open Tasks. Discount Approvals page (nav-approvals) rendered approve-/counter-/reject- buttons and Approve click flipped cost_sheet to approved (verified via subsequent proposal generation success).
critical_code_review_comments: Payment plan milestone field is named 'pct' in the API contract while the seed labels/UI/prompt hint at 'percent'. Consider standardising on one key or accepting both for backward-compat.

Response shapes remain mixed across Section L: cost-sheet/proposal endpoints -> {cost_sheet:{...}} / {proposal:{...}}; discount-approvals list -> {data:[...]} but decide -> {approval:{...}}; lead cost-sheets listing -> {cost_sheets:[...],proposals:[...]}. Unifying under a single envelope would simplify the frontend.

Counter-offer path recomputes discount_amount correctly (verified: 4% of 8M = 320000) but there is no audit note preserving the original requested pct; consider persisting counter_pct + original_pct on DiscountApproval for reporting.
Proposal reference format PROP-YYYYMMDD-XXXX collides risk is low but uniqueness relies on DB unique constraint; ensure a unique index exists on proposals.reference_no.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of exercised flows (plans page, quote tab, cost-sheet create, approvals page, proposal generation via UI evidenced in Activity timeline)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_ / TESTPP_ / TESTNO_ prefixed payment plans and multiple cost sheets attached to a fresh TEST_<uuid> lead. No manual cleanup performed; safe as data is namespaced.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run all backend tests: cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests -v -o addopts=. IMPORTANT contract note: PaymentPlan milestones use key 'pct' (not 'percent') for creation payload. Response shapes for Section L: {cost_sheet:{...}} for create/show/select-plan/share; {proposal:{...}} for generate/send/consent; {data:[...]} for GET /payment-plans and /discount-approvals; {approval:{...}} for decide; {cost_sheets:[...],proposals:[...]} for GET /leads/{id}/cost-sheets. Frontend data-testids verified: nav-plans, nav-approvals, tab-quote, cs-base_price, cs-gst_rate, cs-registration_charges, cs-maintenance_charges, cs-discount_pct, cs-total, cs-create, cost-sheet-<id>, cs-share-<id>, cs-proposal-<id>, approve-<id>, counter-<id>, reject-<id>, prop-send-<id>, prop-consent-<id>, consent-name, consent-save.
